name: pl.podziemieanalityczne/dane
title: Podziemie Analityczne
description: Polish public statistics (GUS, NBP, Eurostat) with unit, period and source. Data tools only read.

tools.name: podziemie_search_series
tools.description: Find series in the catalogue by words (Polish or English) or list a category; returns ids for the other tools. Rows of any publisher beyond gus, nbp, worldbank, eurostat and podziemie come in `outside`, not `items`; rows of a frequency beyond monthly, quarterly and yearly (semiannual, daily) come in `outsideFrequency`.

query.description: Words to find, in Polish or English; empty lists the category (or everything).

category.description: Limit to a legacy category alias, a top category, or one primary leaf. Legacy aliases keep matching the row's category; tree ids match categoryPath.

publisher.description: Limit to one publisher, as the dataset files name it (sejm, utk, oecd, kgp…); podziemie is a series the site derives.

geographyLevel.description: Limit to one geography: Poland as a whole, its voivodeships (NUTS 2 regions included) or countries.

visibility.description: Limit to rows with a page on the site, or to data-only rows.

limit.description: At most this many series (default 10, at most 20).

tools.name: podziemie_describe_series
tools.description: What one series measures: unit, meaning, frequency, coverage, comparability breaks, publisher and licence.

id.description: Public series id: a slug or <dataset>/<dimension>=<code>.

tools.name: podziemie_get_value
tools.description: One reading of a series for a period (the latest when no period is given), with its unit, meaning and a Polish citation.

id.description: Public series id: a slug or <dataset>/<dimension>=<code>.

period.description: YYYY-MM, YYYY-Qn or YYYY, as the series' periodShape says; omit for the latest reading.

tools.name: podziemie_get_series
tools.description: Readings of a series over a range of periods (the last 24 when no range is given), with comparability breaks in the range.

id.description: Public series id: a slug or <dataset>/<dimension>=<code>.

from.description: First period, in the series' periodShape.

to.description: Last period, in the series' periodShape.

tools.name: podziemie_get_releases
tools.description: Release dates with their status (planned, published, late, unconfirmed), and series updated since a day by a new period or a revised value.

id.description: Public series id, as podziemie_describe_series takes; omit for every series.

from.description: First release day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 7 days ago; at most 90 days back).

to.description: Last release day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: every known date).

updatedSince.description: List series updated on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 7 days ago; at most 30 days back).

tools.name: podziemie_find_members
tools.description: Find the code of a place or country by name or code in the shared code lists, with its level and parent: geography takes a Polish voivodeship name or TERYT code and, once places launch, a powiat, gmina (TERC) or village (SIMC) name or code, a village with its gmina and an abolished unit with its end date (podziemie_get_place reads their values); country takes a Polish or English name or an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code (the Eurostat codes UK and EL also work); with dataset, the series ids for the other tools. Several fitting names come back as ambiguous.

dimension.description: Shared dimension: geography holds TERYT codes, country ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes and publisher area aggregates.

query.description: A name or code, with or without Polish diacritics: geography by Polish name or TERYT code ("Mazowieckie", "14"; once places launch also "bocheński", "Nowy Wiśnicz", "1201063" or a village name); country by Polish or English name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code ("Niemcy", "Germany", "DE", "DEU"; "UK" and "EL" are Eurostat codes, ISO has GB and GR). Omit to list.

containedIn.description: A TERYT code: only members inside it, e.g. "12" for the members inside Małopolskie.

level.description: Only members of this level; village is a member with no level of its own.

dataset.description: A dataset id, e.g. "bezrobocie-wojewodztwa": only its members, each with its series id.

limit.description: At most this many members (default 20, at most 50).

tools.name: podziemie_get_observations
tools.description: Read up to 20 series ids or a member dataset with named dimension filters. One call with dataset and no filter returns every member of the dataset (all 16 voivodeships of a voivodeship dataset), so no call per member is needed. A family that is not a member dataset (pay or flat prices by voivodeship) is read with all its ids in one call, e.g. the 16 ids of one podziemie_search_series answer with limit 16 (its default is 10), not one call per id. Returns the last 24 periods by default, at most 1,500 cells and 24,000 characters, with Polish citations, licences and a cursor plus data links for the rest; the text holds every value too. When the answer holds only part of the request, its text starts "Series a to b of n" and names what is missing: call again with nextCursor before comparing the series.

ids.description: 1 to 20 series ids: a slug (from podziemie_search_series) or <dataset>/<dimension>=<code>.

dataset.description: A member dataset, e.g. "bezrobocie-wojewodztwa"; use instead of ids.

filter.description: With dataset: {<dimension>: code | [codes] | "*"}; omitted means every member.

from.description: First period, in each series' periodShape.

to.description: Last period, in each series' periodShape.

lastN.description: The last n periods (default 24 without a range).

detail.description: full adds raw values, coverage, readingBasis (concise states it in each citation) and identity fields.

tools.name: podziemie_related_series
tools.description: The accepted, current links stored for a series, the record its page takes its links from: formula inputs, components, price-chain steps, publisher-stated mechanisms and reviewed "see also" series, each with its kind, tier, basis and direction. Navigation hints, not proof of a cause.

id.description: Public series id: a slug or <dataset>/<dimension>=<code>.

kinds.description: Only links of these kinds; default every kind.

tiers.description: core: a formula, component, price-chain step or publisher-stated mechanism; worth_seeing: a reviewed "see also" pointer, never a cause. Default both.

tools.name: podziemie_get_neighbours
tools.description: Every series to walk to from one series, as the dependency map on the site draws it: stored links with their direction and evidence (the stored basis), other measures of the same concept, the same measure at a neighbouring place or for the whole country, and other measures at the same place. With familyTable it also returns the family table its site page shows: every member's latest value, unit and change, and, where the family compares with Polska, the gap to Polska and the place. Call it again on a neighbour to walk on. Navigation hints, not proof of a cause.

id.description: Public series id: a slug or <dataset>/<dimension>=<code>.

relations.description: Only these relations; default every one. variant: another measure of the same concept; family: the same measure one step away (a neighbouring place, the whole country, another group); place: another measure at the same place; the rest are stored links.

limit.description: At most this many neighbours, in the map's order; default every one.

familyTable.description: Also return the family table the series' page shows: each member's latest value, unit and change, and the gap to Polska and the place where the family compares with Polska. It reads up to about a hundred series, so it is off by default.

tools.name: podziemie_poznaj
tools.description: The site's profile of Poland (Poznaj Polskę) as one tree: twelve segments (population, work, prices, the economy, regions and more), each with its headline's latest reading and the page it leads to. A segment with its own page adds its year range, the series and table ids its charts draw, its facts and its links. The same tree as GET /api/poznaj.

segment.description: One segment by its id; default every segment.

tools.name: podziemie_list_dashboards
tools.description: The dashboards (Polish UI: raporty): the site's own (kind ours), then readers' public ones, the most followed first (kind reader, with followers; at most 100, no author). Each with slug, title, description, page and JSON address; podziemie_get_dashboard reads one by its slug. readersUnavailable: true says the readers' list could not be read just now.

tools.name: podziemie_get_dashboard
tools.description: One dashboard (Polish UI: raport), ours by slug or a user's public one by its address: the podziemie.dashboard/1 document (its tiles hold no values) and, for each series it draws, the podziemie_get_value answer for its latest reading: value, period and citation, or why there is none. A table by place it draws is named in tables, for podziemie_get_observations with dataset. The same answer as the dashboard's address with .json.

report.description: A slug from podziemie_list_dashboards, or a public user report's address (https://…/raporty/<title>-<code>).

tools.name: podziemie_get_place
tools.description: One powiat, gmina or village (its codelist and code from podziemie_find_members): the newest value of every published place table for it, each with its period, unit, source line, and its rank among the units of its level or why it has none (villages and places too small to rank have none). A value GUS withholds comes back null, never 0. An abolished unit answers with its end date and no value. Answers not-available until places launch.

codelist.description: The place list, as podziemie_find_members names it: teryt-powiaty (powiat), teryt-gminy (gmina, TERC with its type digit) or simc-miejscowosci (village).

code.description: The place's code in that list, e.g. "1201" (powiat), "1201063" (gmina) or "0950463" (village).

tools.name: podziemie_draft_dashboard
tools.description: Stores a podziemie.dashboard/1 document as a private draft for 24 hours and returns its link. Not listed anywhere; whoever opens the link can read it, and the person signs in there to save it to their dashboards (Polish UI: raporty). A document that fails the checks is not stored, and each problem comes back with its JSON pointer.

dashboard.description: A podziemie.dashboard/1 document as JSON text: {"$schema":"podziemie.dashboard/1","title":…,"tiles":[…]}, the shape of podziemie_get_dashboard's `dashboard` (chart, number and text tiles).
